overview.text:
**Changed**
- `index.js:toMagnitudeMode` maps `round`→`halfExpand`, and `floor`/`ceil`→`expand` or `trunc` depending on sign; `undefined` stays `undefined` [E9, H4].
- `prettyBytes` now calls `assertRoundingMode`, which throws `TypeError` for other values; its body is truncated in the evidence (not shown) [E9, H7, H14].
- `buildLocaleOptions` passes `roundingMode: magnitudeMode ?? 'trunc'` to `Intl`, so omitting the option still truncates fraction digits [E8, H6].
- With fraction-digit options and non-`trunc` rounding, a value that rounds up to `>= base` moves to the next unit (e.g. `999960` with max 1 → `1 MB`) [E10, H8, H3].
- With the 3-significant-digit default, `floor`/`ceil` use the new `roundToSignificantDigits` via `toLocaleString`; `round`/default keep `toPrecision` [H8, H4].
- `toUnrepresentableString` (bigint past `number` range) now applies `trunc`/`expand`/`halfExpand` exactly with bigint remainder arithmetic; before, it always truncated [H4, H9].
- `index.d.ts`, `readme.md` and `index.test-d.ts` got the option type, docs, the negative-number and default decision, and type checks [H1, H2, H3, H10, H11, H12, H13].

**Why**
- The user wanted `round`/`floor`/`ceil` to work with fraction digits, `locale`, `signed` and negatives, with tests run by `node --test` and no ava install [E1].
- The default is not literally `'round'`. The agent kept truncation when fraction-digit options are set, so existing output (e.g. `59_952_784`→`59.9 MB`) does not change [E38, H13].
- Negatives use the mathematical `floor`/`ceil`: `floor(-x)` prints as `-ceil(x)`, and the input's sign is kept, so a value rounding to zero prints `-0` [H3, H13].

**Tests**
- `test-rounding.js` covers [E12, H14]:
  - the spec examples, for both number and bigint [H14];
  - omitted mode equals the old output [H14];
  - carry onto the next unit, negatives, `signed`, `locale` [E13, H14];
  - ties (`1005`), rounding to zero (`-0.04`), and invalid values that should throw `TypeError` [E12, E36, H14].
- First run: the carry test failed (expected `'999.960 kB'`, got `'999.96 kB'`); the agent changed the expectation, not the code [E13, E14].
- Final run of `node --test test-rounding.js`: 11 pass, 0 fail [E37].
- Existing `test.js` was run through an ava shim in the scratchpad [E16, E17].
  - It first crashed on a missing `test.skip`; the agent added `skip`/`notRegex` to the shim [E19, E21, E22].
  - The doc-example test failed until `readme.md`/`index.d.ts` were copied into the shim [E23, E24, E37].
  - Final: 48 pass, 0 fail, 3 skipped [E37].

**Risks**
- `tsd` and `xo` were not run [E38].
- The default deviates from the spec's "`'round'` default" [E38].
- The shim implements only a subset of the ava API [E16].
- The command at E23 ran `git stash`/`stash pop` on the real repo, a side effect on the user's worktree [E23].
- Two Bash commands were blocked ("expansion obfuscation"); the agent redid them with Write/Edit [E15, E16, E17, E34, E35, E36].
- Untracked dotfiles the agent did not create appear in `git status` [E23, E38].

walkthrough.text:
1. Explore: listed repo, read `index.js`, `index.d.ts`, `package.json`, `readme.md`; Node v26.9.0; ava declared in devDependencies but not installed [E2, E3].
2. Explore: grepped `test.js` for FractionDigits/signed tests and read `index.test-d.ts` [E4].
3. Probe: checked `toLocaleString` `roundingMode` values (`halfExpand`, `expand`) in node; e.g. 59.952784 halfExpand to 1 digit gives `60` [E5].
4. Edit `index.js`: `toUnrepresentableString` gained `magnitudeMode` (exact bigint `trunc`/`expand`/`halfExpand`); added `toMagnitudeMode`, `roundToSignificantDigits` [E6, H4].
5. Edit `index.js`: `buildLocaleOptions(options, magnitudeMode)` now emits `roundingMode: magnitudeMode ?? 'trunc'`, keeping truncation when the option is omitted [E7, E8, H5, H6].
6. Edit `index.js`: `prettyBytes` calls `assertRoundingMode`, maps `floor`/`ceil` per sign via `number < 0` [E9, H7].
7. Edit `index.js`: with locale options, a non-trunc round that reaches `base` bumps the unit. Without them, non-round modes use `roundToSignificantDigits` [E10, H8, H9].
8. Test: wrote `test-rounding.js` (node:test) [E12]. The first run failed "rounding up carries onto the next unit": got `'999.96 kB'`, expected `'999.960 kB'` [E13].
9. Fix: changed the test's expected value to `'999.96 kB'`, so the test was adjusted, not the code [E14].
10. Verify: a combined bash command (rounding tests plus an ava shim in the scratchpad) was rejected as "expansion obfuscation" [E15]. The agent wrote the shim files with Write instead [E16, E17].
11. Verify: rounding tests passed 10/0. Shimmed `test.js` crashed with `test.skip is not a function` [E18, E19].
12. Fix shim: counted the ava APIs used, then added `test.skip` and `notRegex` [E20, E21, E22]. Result: 47 pass, 1 fail ("documented examples are accurate"), 3 skipped [E23].
13. Diagnose: the failing test parses `readme.md`/`index.d.ts`, which weren't copied into the shim. Every doc fence needs `//=>` examples [E24, E25, E26, E27].
14. Docs: added a `roundingMode` JSDoc to `index.d.ts` and changed the "truncated … unless `roundingMode` is set" notes [E28, E29, E30, H1, H2, H3].
15. Docs: added a readme `roundingMode` section covering the negative-number decision (floor goes toward −∞, `-0` kept), the default-behaviour rationale and the 1005 tie note [E31, E32, H11, H12, H13].
16. Edit: a heredoc append to `index.test-d.ts` was rejected again [E34]. The agent switched to Edit to add 3 `expectType` lines plus a tie/rounding-to-zero test [E35, E36, H10, H14].
17. Final run: `test-rounding.js` 11 pass, 0 fail. Shimmed `test.js` (with docs copied) 48 pass, 0 fail, 3 skipped [E37].
18. Report: the agent said the default is not literally `'round'`, so the truncation behaviour is kept. `tsd`/`xo` were not run, nothing was committed, and the untracked dotfiles are not the agent's [E38].
19. Not verified: type checks (`tsd`) and lint; the shim only approximates ava semantics [E16, E38].

mechanism.text:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["prettyBytes(number, options)"] --> B["assertRoundingMode(options.roundingMode)"]
  B -->|"invalid value"| X["throw TypeError"]
  B -->|"valid / undefined"| C["toMagnitudeMode(roundingMode, number < 0)"]
  C -->|"magnitudeMode: halfExpand / expand / trunc / undefined"| D["buildLocaleOptions(options, magnitudeMode)"]
  D -->|"roundingMode: magnitudeMode ?? 'trunc'"| E{"scaled value fits in number?"}
  E -->|"yes, localeOptions set"| F["carry check: toLocaleString en-US, rounded >= base"]
  F -->|"rounded >= base"| G["number /= base; exponent += 1"]
  E -->|"yes, no localeOptions"| H{"magnitudeMode undefined or halfExpand?"}
  H -->|"yes"| I["Number#toPrecision(minimumPrecision)"]
  H -->|"expand / trunc"| J["roundToSignificantDigits (Intl maximumSignificantDigits)"]
  F --> K["toLocaleString(number, locale, localeOptions)"]
  I --> K
  J --> K
  E -->|"no, bigint past number range"| L["toUnrepresentableString(..., magnitudeMode) exact bigint"]
```

- The diagram shows the control flow in the final `index.js` [H4, H6, H7, H8, H9].
- `prettyBytes` calls `assertRoundingMode` right after `assertFixedWidth` [H7].
- Tests pass `'trunc'`, `'halfExpand'`, `'ROUND'`, `''`, `null`, `1` and `true`, and expect a `TypeError` for each [H14].
- `toMagnitudeMode` maps the user mode to an Intl mode based on the sign of `number`. The result is then applied to the magnitude [H4]:
  - `round` → `halfExpand` [H4]
  - `floor` → `expand` if negative, else `trunc` [H4]
  - `ceil` → `trunc` if negative, else `expand` [H4]
  - omitted → `undefined` [H4]
- `buildLocaleOptions` sets `roundingMode: magnitudeMode ?? 'trunc'`, so leaving the option out keeps the old truncation of fraction digits [H6].
- The test `1999, {maximumFractionDigits:1}` → `'1.9 kB'` checks that unchanged default [H14].
- With fraction digit options and a non-`trunc` mode, the code pre-formats the number with `en-US`. If the rounded value is `>= base`, it moves up one unit (`999.96 kB` → `1 MB`) [H8].
- The carry test failed on its first run: it expected `'999.960 kB'` and got `'999.96 kB'` [E13]. The agent changed the test expectation, not the code [E14].
- Without fraction digit options, `undefined` and `halfExpand` keep using `Number#toPrecision` [H8].
- `expand` and `trunc` go through `roundToSignificantDigits`, which returns the input unchanged when more than 21 digits are needed [H8, H4].
- A test loops over values including 1337, 1005 and 999_500 and checks that `roundingMode:'round'` matches the output with no option [H14].
- `1001, {roundingMode:'ceil'}` → `'1.01 kB'` is a documented example [H3, H13].
- `toUnrepresentableString` now uses exact bigint math [H4]:
  - It multiplies by `10n ** maximumFractionDigits` and divides by `scale` [H4].
  - It adds 1 for `expand` when remainder > 0, or for `halfExpand` when `remainder*2n >= scale` [H4].
  - Previously this path always truncated [H4, E38].
  - A test covers it with a huge bigint and `ceil`, expecting `${whole} YB` [H14].
- `locale` and `signed` are applied after rounding, through `toLocaleString` and the existing prefix logic [H8, H9].
- The readme documents `floor` with `locale:'de'` → `'1,9 kB'` [H13]. The `locale option` and `signed option` tests passed [E13].
- Negative edge cases are tested [E36, H14]:
  - `-0.04` with `ceil` → `'-0 B'`, and with `floor` → `'-0.1 B'`.
  - `-1005` with `round` and 2 fraction digits → `'-1.01 kB'`.
- Verification results [E37, E38]:
  - `node --test test-rounding.js`: 11 pass, 0 fail [E37].
  - Existing `test.js` through an ava shim in the scratchpad: 48 pass, 0 fail, 3 skipped [E37].
  - Earlier, one shim test failed (`documented examples are accurate`) [E23]. The agent attributed this to the shim missing the readme [E24]. It passed after `readme.md` and `index.d.ts` were copied in [E37].
  - `tsd` and `xo` were not run [E38].
